verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an agent framework, but the evidence pack documents no user-definable rules or triggers that fire actions on events. The cited items cover adjacent capabilities only: LLM tool calling, MCP toolsets, turn detection, interruption handling, and programmatic participants that a developer could build such logic on. None of these counts as a rules or automation feature, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
